description: Capability for the main window and the pop-out speech-doc windows. The trailing -* is REQUIRED: docBridge labels each pop-out 'speech-doc-<docId>', and a bare 'speech-doc' matches no window at all — which left every pop-out with zero grants, so 'Dock back' (close), tilde-send (emit) and star-doc routing (listen) all silently did nothing.
